definitions.gloss: to gaze at, to look at
definitions.explanation: To look at something for a prolonged time.
To observe scenery or consider something.

notes:
{眺|なが}める is an ichidan verb meaning to gaze at or look at something in a leisurely, contemplative manner.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive - takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark what is being gazed at.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{眺|なが}める: to gaze at the scenery
- ⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{眺|なが}める: to gaze at the night sky
- ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{眺|なが}める: to look out from the window
- ⟦ぼんやり→ぼんやり：03727_bonyari⟧{眺|なが}める: to gaze absentmindedly
- ⟦じっと→じっと：01571_jitto⟧{眺|なが}める: to gaze intently

FORMS:
- ⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧ (noun): view, scenery
- ⟦{眺望|ちょうぼう}→眺望：20013_choubou⟧: panoramic view

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at, see (general, neutral)
- ⟦{見|み}つめる→見つめる：04571_mitsumeru⟧: to stare at, gaze fixedly
- {眺|なが}める: to gaze at (leisurely, contemplative)
- ⟦{観|み}る→観る：22793_miru⟧: to watch, view (entertainment, shows)

USAGE:
{眺|なが}める implies taking time to appreciate what you're looking at, often scenery or something beautiful. It suggests a relaxed, contemplative state rather than quick observation.
